title: Turnover of organic matter and the mineral nitrogen it releases
intro: K NH4 [h-1 ]: Maximal immobilization rate for ammonium; K NO3 [h-1 ]: Maximal immobilization rate for nitrate; CO2 threshold [h-1 ]: Turnover rate above which pools will contribute to 'CO2 fast'. Each is varied from half to double the value the farm uses; K NH4, K NO3, CO2 threshold moved the yield, water or nitrogen in the test.
